 1101: remote_scope_failure_reasons(Config) ->
 1102:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1103:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, {blocked, bob}},
 1104:     Recover = {';', Remote,
 1105:                {get_fail_reasons,
 1106:                 [{'Outer'}, {blocked, bob}, {impossible_to_link, bob}]}},
 1107:     ?assertMatch(
 1108:        {ok, [#{'Outer' := Remote}], _},
 1109:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1110:                  [?ASKER_NS, Recover], 60000)).
 1111: 
 1112: %% The C predicate name is compiled only on B/C. A relays it without allocating
 1113: %% an atom; C materializes it after authenticating the scoped command. A's
 1114: %% declared recovery rule then matches C's reason after it returns through B.
 1115: remote_scope_nested_failure_reasons(Config) ->
 1116:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1117:     ?assertMatch(
 1118:        {ok, [#{}], _},
 1119:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1120:                  [?ASKER_NS, recover_third_failure], 60000)),
 1121:     ?assertEqual(
 1122:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', <<"third_blocked">>}},
 1123:        peer:call(Asker, quod_wire_term, decode,
 1124:                  [{0, <<"third_blocked">>}])),
 1125:     assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
 1126:       Asker, ?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS,
 1127:       ?config(third_pub, Config), ?config(third_addr, Config),
 1128:       <<"third_blocked">>).
 1129: 
 1130: remote_scope_deep_failure_reasons(Config) ->
 1131:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1132:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, {deep_failure, 70}},
 1133:     {fail, Reasons} = peer:call(
 1134:                         Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1135:                         [?ASKER_NS, Remote], 60000),
 1136:     ?assert(length(Reasons) > 64),
 1137:     ?assertEqual(Remote, hd(Reasons)),
 1138:     ?assertEqual({'$quod_symbol', <<"deep_bottom">>}, lists:last(Reasons)),
 1139:     assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
 1140:       Asker, ?config(target, Config), ?NS,
 1141:       ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
 1142:       <<"deep_bottom">>).
 1143: 
 1144: assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
 1145:   Asker, Host, Ns, HostKey, Endpoint, SymbolName) ->
 1146:     Anchor = peer:call(Host, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
 1147:     ?assertMatch(
 1148:        {ok, #{identity := {Ns, Anchor}}},
 1149:        peer:call(
 1150:          Asker, quod_foreign_log, current,
 1151:          [[{HostKey, [Endpoint]}], {Ns, Anchor}, 20000], 25000)),
 1152:     %% current/3 must be able to certify and retain the complete foreign
 1153:     %% history without interning that ontology's application vocabulary.
 1154:     ?assertEqual(
 1155:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', SymbolName}},
 1156:        peer:call(Asker, quod_wire_term, decode, [{0, SymbolName}])).
 1157: 
 1158: remote_scope_structural_reason_truncation(Config) ->
 1159:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1160:     %% A deep value at the wire boundary must survive intact.  This makes the
 1161:     %% over-depth assertion below non-vacuous: the recursive builder really is
 1162:     %% compiled and its binding crosses the remote proof boundary.
 1163:     Legal = {'::', ?NS, bounded_reason},
 1164:     {fail, LegalReasons} = peer:call(
 1165:                              Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1166:                              [?ASKER_NS, Legal], 60000),
 1167:     {ok, Bottom} = peer:call(
 1168:                      Asker, quod_wire_term, decode,
 1169:                      [{0, <<"deep_bottom">>}]),
 1170:     LegalReason = lists:foldl(
 1171:                     fun(_, Acc) -> [Acc] end, Bottom,
 1172:                     lists:seq(1, 63)),
 1173:     ?assert(lists:member(LegalReason, LegalReasons)),
 1174:     ?assert(quod_wire_term:valid_failure_reason_stack(LegalReasons)),
 1175: 
 1176:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, deep_reason},
 1177:     {fail, Reasons} = peer:call(
 1178:                         Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1179:                         [?ASKER_NS, Remote], 60000),
 1180:     ?assertEqual(Remote, hd(Reasons)),
 1181:     ?assert(lists:member(deep_reason, Reasons)),
 1182:     ?assert(lists:member(fail_reasons_truncated, Reasons)),
 1183:     ?assert(quod_wire_term:valid_failure_reason_stack(Reasons)).
 1184: 
 1185: remote_scope_cancel(Config) ->
 1186:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1187:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1188:     Loop = {'::', ?NS, loop},
 1189:     Caller = peer:call(Asker, erlang, spawn,
 1190:                        [quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Loop]]),
 1191:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 1, 200),
 1192:     true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [Caller, kill]),
 1193:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200).
 1194: 
 1195: %% Scope commands share the bounded node-level router without sharing proof
 1196: %% state. Two full waves prove that completed scopes release every target worker
 1197: %% and leave the transport reusable for independent proofs.
 1198: remote_scope_transport_reuse(Config) ->
 1199:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1200:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1201:     Goal = {'::', ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}},
 1202:     run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, first),
 1203:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200),
 1204:     run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, second),
 1205:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200).
 1206: 
 1207: %% The browser is logged into A as an agent stored in A. Exact selectors reach
 1208: %% B through the ordinary scope path. A has no ACL clause for these goals, so
 1209: %% success proves that A authenticates identity while B alone authorizes B's
 1210: %% predicate.
 1211: remote_signed_gateway_read_execute_cursor(Config) ->
 1212:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1213:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1214:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1215:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1216:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1217:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1218:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1219:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1220: 
 1221:     {ReadBytes, ReadSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1222:                                    NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1223:                                    ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1224:                                    maps:get(expires_ms, Session), read,
 1225:                                    <<"\"animals\"::diet(dog, D).">>),
 1226:     {ok, ReadEvidence,
 1227:      {normalized, {read, ReadDependencies, {answers, ReadHeight, ReadBlobs}}}} =
 1228:         peer:call(
 1229:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1230:           [read, maps:get(session_id, Session), ReadBytes, ReadSignature, Peer],
 1231:           60000),
 1232:     ?assertEqual({?ASKER_NS,AgentAnchor,ReadHeight},
 1233:         lists:keyfind(?ASKER_NS,1,ReadDependencies)),
 1234:     ?assertEqual({?NS,?config(target_anchor,Config),
 1235:                   peer:call(?config(target,Config),quod_prolog,applied,[?NS])},
 1236:         lists:keyfind(?NS,1,ReadDependencies)),
 1237:     ?assertEqual(ReadBytes, maps:get(request_bytes, ReadEvidence)),
 1238:     ?assertEqual(ReadSignature, maps:get(signature, ReadEvidence)),
 1239:     ?assertEqual(
 1240:        [[{<<"D">>, kibble}]],
 1241:        [begin {ok, Binding} = quod_durable_term:decode_result(Blob), Binding end
 1242:         || Blob <- ReadBlobs]),
 1243:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1244:     ExecuteText = iolist_to_binary(
 1245:                     io_lib:format("assertz(gateway_mark(~B)).", [Tag])),
 1246:     {ExecuteBytes, ExecuteSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1247:                                          NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1248:                                          ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1249:                                          maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1250:                                          execute,
 1251:                                          <<"\"animals\"::", ExecuteText/binary>>),
 1252:     {ok, ExecuteEvidence,
 1253:      {normalized,
 1254:       {committed, [_],
 1255:        {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} = ExecuteTargetRef}}} =
 1256:         peer:call(
 1257:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1258:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), ExecuteBytes,
 1259:            ExecuteSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1260:     ?assertEqual(
 1261:        ExecuteTargetRef,
 1262:        completed_remote_operation(
 1263:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, ExecuteEvidence), 600)),
 1264:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_mark, Tag),
 1265: 
 1266:     CursorText =
 1267:         <<"\"animals\"::(diet(dog, D), assertz(gateway_choice(D))).">>,
 1268:     {CursorBytes, CursorSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1269:                                        NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1270:                                        ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1271:                                        maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1272:                                        cursor, CursorText),
 1273:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1274:      {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, FirstBlob}}} =
 1275:         peer:call(
 1276:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1277:           [cursor, maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorBytes,
 1278:            CursorSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1279:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"D">>, kibble}]},
 1280:                  quod_durable_term:decode_result(FirstBlob)),
 1281:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1282:      {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, SecondBlob}}} =
 1283:         peer:call(
 1284:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1285:           [maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorId, next, Peer], 60000),
 1286:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"D">>, meat}]},
 1287:                  quod_durable_term:decode_result(SecondBlob)),
 1288:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1289:      {normalized,
 1290:       {committed, [_],
 1291:        {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} = CursorTargetRef}}} =
 1292:         peer:call(
 1293:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1294:           [maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorId, accept, Peer], 60000),
 1295:     ?assertEqual(
 1296:        CursorTargetRef,
 1297:        completed_remote_operation(
 1298:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, CursorEvidence), 600)),
 1299:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_choice, meat),
 1300: 
 1301:     {StopBytes, StopSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1302:                                    NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1303:                                    ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1304:                                    maps:get(expires_ms, Session), cursor,
 1305:                                    <<"\"animals\"::diet(dog, D).">>),
 1306:     {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, StopCursor, _, _}}} =
 1307:         peer:call(
 1308:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1309:           [cursor, maps:get(session_id, Session), StopBytes,
 1310:            StopSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1311:     ?assertMatch(
 1312:        {ok, _, {normalized, stopped}},
 1313:        peer:call(
 1314:          Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1315:          [maps:get(session_id, Session), StopCursor, stop, Peer], 60000)).
 1316: 
 1317: %% B contributes only a certified read. C remains the sole writer, so this is
 1318: %% one ordinary remote operation claim and target transaction, never a DTX
 1319: %% group with an empty source Vote/Resolve role for B.
 1320: remote_signed_read_certified_write(Config) ->
 1321:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1322:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1323:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1324:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1325:                  io_lib:format(
 1326:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble), "
 1327:                    "\"third\"::dtx_write(~B).", [Tag])),
 1328:     {ok, Evidence,
 1329:      {normalized,
 1330:       {committed, [_],
 1331:        {transaction, ?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, _} = TargetRef}}} =
 1332:         submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText),
 1333:     ?assertEqual(
 1334:        ThirdAnchor,
 1335:        peer:call(Third, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?THIRD_NS])),
 1336:     ?assertEqual(
 1337:        TargetRef,
 1338:        completed_remote_operation(
 1339:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), 600)),
 1340:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag).
 1341: 
 1342: %% R4-UNCERTAIN-CLAIM-DELIVERY-01: this is a real signed operation admitted
 1343: %% through the ordinary client, source consensus, and remote target. Once it
 1344: %% is accepted, deliver the SAME durable claim twice more through the real
 1345: %% endpoint. Only the transport correlation id changes. No hand-built claim,
 1346: %% new signed goal, new application identity, or admission bypass is used.
 1347: remote_exact_claim_redelivery(Config) ->
 1348:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1349:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1350:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1351:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1352:              "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble), \"third\"::dtx_write(~B).", [Tag])),
 1353:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_],
 1354:         {transaction, ?THIRD_NS, Anchor, TxId} = TargetRef}}} =
 1355:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal),
 1356:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 1357:     ?assertEqual(TargetRef, completed_remote_operation(Asker, OperationRef, 600)),
 1358:     {ok, #{height := ClaimSlot}} = peer:call(
 1359:         Asker, quod_prolog, local_outcome, [?ASKER_NS, OperationRef]),
 1360:     Deadline = peer:call(Asker, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 1361:     {ok, CertifiedClaimRef, Claim} = peer:call(
 1362:         Asker, quod_simplex, operation_claim_evidence,
 1363:         [?ASKER_NS, ClaimSlot, OperationRef, Deadline]),
 1364:     {ok, ClaimBytes} = quod_transaction:encode_evidence(CertifiedClaimRef, Claim),
 1365:     Target = {?THIRD_NS, Anchor},
 1366:     StableClaimRef = quod_transaction:stable_ref(CertifiedClaimRef),
 1367:     ?assertMatch(#transaction{tx_id = TxId},
 1368:         quod_transaction:remote_application(StableClaimRef, Claim, Target)),
 1369:     Before = peer:call(Third, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences,
 1370:                        [?THIRD_NS, TxId]),
 1371:     ?assertMatch([_], Before),
 1372:     lists:foreach(fun(_) ->
 1373:         ?assertEqual({ok, ClaimBytes},
 1374:                      quod_transaction:encode_evidence(CertifiedClaimRef, Claim)),
 1375:         RequestId = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16),
 1376:         Request = {apply_claim, RequestId, Target, ClaimBytes},
 1377:         {ok, {application, RequestId, committed, ApplicationBytes} = Response,
 1378:          _Hints} =
 1379:             peer:call(Asker, quod_dtx_current_view, submit_claim_application,
 1380:                       [?ASKER_NS, Target, Claim, Request, 5000], 10000),
 1381:         ?assert(quod_dtx_endpoint:correlates(Request, Response)),
 1382:         {ok, ApplicationRef, #transaction{tx_id = TxId,
 1383:             role = {remote_application, _, _, _}}} =
 1384:             quod_transaction:decode_evidence(ApplicationBytes),
 1385:         ?assertEqual(TargetRef, quod_transaction:stable_ref(ApplicationRef)),
 1386:         ?assertEqual(Before, peer:call(Third, ?MODULE,
 1387:             claim_application_occurrences, [?THIRD_NS, TxId])),
 1388:         assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag)
 1389:     end, [first_redelivery, second_redelivery]).
 1390: 
 1391: %% Test-side audit only, executed ON the target. An ordinary immutable owner
 1392: %% snapshot is read without returning any store or interpreter state to the
 1393: %% caller. Count ledger occurrences as well as visible facts: an extra inert
 1394: %% or rejected envelope must not hide a second application under the same id.
 1395: claim_application_occurrences(Ns, TxId) ->
 1396:     {ok, #{snapshot := Snapshot, slot := Height}} =
 1397:         quod_simplex:history_view(Ns, any, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1398:     {ok, Store} = quod_ledger_store:open_ro_snapshot(Snapshot),
 1399:     try
 1400:         lists:reverse(quod_ledger_store:fold(Store, 1, Height,
 1401:             fun(Entry, Acc) ->
 1402:                 case quod_ledger:entry_view(Entry) of
 1403:                     #entry{index = Slot, data = {batch, Transactions}} ->
 1404:                         [Slot || #transaction{tx_id = Id,
 1405:                             role = {remote_application, _, _, _}} <- Transactions,
 1406:                             Id =:= TxId] ++ Acc;
 1407:                     _ -> Acc
 1408:                 end
 1409:             end, []))
 1410:     after quod_ledger_store:close(Store)
 1411:     end.
 1412: 
 1413: %% A writes locally while B contributes only a certified read. The result is
 1414: %% A's ordinary transaction; there is no source claim and no DTX group.
 1415: local_write_with_foreign_read(Config) ->
 1416:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1417:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1418:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1419:                  io_lib:format(
 1420:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1421:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble).", [Tag])),
 1422:     ?assertMatch(
 1423:        {ok, _,
 1424:         {normalized,
 1425:          {committed, [_], {transaction, ?ASKER_NS, _, _}}}},
 1426:        submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)),
 1427:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag).
 1428: 
 1429: %% The read token is sealed first. B then commits another diet/2 fact before
 1430: %% its validators sign the certificate. Certification must reject the stale
 1431: %% token and A's local write must remain absent.
 1432: read_certificate_stale_rejected(Config) ->
 1433:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1434:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1435:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1436:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1437:                  io_lib:format(
 1438:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1439:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble).", [Tag])),
 1440:     ok = peer:call(
 1441:            Asker, quod_prolog,
 1442:            test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1443:     Parent = self(),
 1444:     RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1445:     _ = spawn(
 1446:           fun() ->
 1447:               Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)}
 1448:           end),
 1449:     try
 1450:         ok = peer:call(
 1451:                Asker, quod_prolog,
 1452:                test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1453:         ?assertMatch(
 1454:            {ok, [_], _},
 1455:            peer:call(
 1456:              Target, quod_prolog, prove,
 1457:              [?NS, {assertz, {diet, dog, {stale_marker, Tag}}}],
 1458:              60000))
 1459:     after
 1460:         %% Never leave the TEST-only rendezvous installed if an assertion
 1461:         %% above fails: a later proof would otherwise correctly wait forever.
 1462:         _ = peer:call(
 1463:               Asker, quod_prolog,
 1464:               test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1465:     end,
 1466:     Result = receive
 1467:                  {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1468:              after 60000 ->
 1469:                  ct:fail(stale_read_request_did_not_finish)
 1470:              end,
 1471:     ?assertMatch(
 1472:        {ok, _, {normalized, {error, conflict_retry}}}, Result),
 1473:     assert_fact_absent(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag).
 1474: 
 1475: %% The signed claim lane treats A's own read exactly like any other read-only
 1476: %% dependency. If A changes after sealing but before certification, neither the
 1477: %% source claim nor C's write may be submitted.
 1478: remote_signed_origin_read_certificate_stale_rejected(Config) ->
 1479:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1480:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1481:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1482:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1483:                  io_lib:format(
 1484:                    "instance_of(pet, my_dog), \"third\"::dtx_write(~B).",
 1485:                    [Tag])),
 1486:     ok = peer:call(
 1487:            Asker, quod_prolog,
 1488:            test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1489:     Parent = self(),
 1490:     RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1491:     _ = spawn(
 1492:           fun() ->
 1493:               Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)}
 1494:           end),
 1495:     try
 1496:         ok = peer:call(
 1497:                Asker, quod_prolog,
 1498:                test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1499:         %% The source proof is deliberately parked before its certificate.
 1500:         %% Commit the intervening source-head change at the consensus seam so
 1501:         %% this test does not depend on a second client ingress being admitted
 1502:         %% while the first signed request still owns that ingress session.
 1503:         append_source_marker(Config, Tag)
 1504:     after
 1505:         _ = peer:call(
 1506:               Asker, quod_prolog,
 1507:               test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1508:     end,
 1509:     Result = receive
 1510:                  {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1511:              after 60000 ->
 1512:                  ct:fail(origin_stale_read_request_did_not_finish)
 1513:              end,
 1514:     ?assertMatch(
 1515:        {ok, _, {normalized, {error, conflict_retry}}}, Result),
 1516:     assert_fact_absent(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag).
 1517: 
 1518: %% Two independent gateways race the same signed execute. One may receive a
 1519: %% typed pre-custody availability refusal while the other proof is sealing;
 1520: %% the stable operation claim must still give both gateways one durable result
 1521: %% and one material write.
 1522: remote_signed_two_gateway_race(Config) ->
 1523:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1524:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1525:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1526:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1527:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1528:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1529:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1530:     AskerSession = open_client_session(
 1531:                      Asker, NetworkId, ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 1532:                      AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1533:     ThirdSession = open_client_session(
 1534:                      Third, NetworkId, ?config(third_pub, Config),
 1535:                      AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1536:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1537:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1538:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1539:                  io_lib:format(
 1540:                    "\"animals\"::assertz(gateway_race_mark(~B)).", [Tag])),
 1541:     Expires = min(maps:get(expires_ms, AskerSession),
 1542:                   maps:get(expires_ms, ThirdSession)),
 1543:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1544:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1545:                                   ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1546:                                   Expires, execute, GoalText),
 1547:     Parent = self(),
 1548:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 1549:     _ = spawn(
 1550:           fun() ->
 1551:               Parent !
 1552:                 {RaceRef, asker,
 1553:                  peer:call(
 1554:                    Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1555:                    [execute, maps:get(session_id, AskerSession),
 1556:                     RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1557:           end),
 1558:     _ = spawn(
 1559:           fun() ->
 1560:               Parent !
 1561:                 {RaceRef, third,
 1562:                  peer:call(
 1563:                    Third, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1564:                    [execute, maps:get(session_id, ThirdSession),
 1565:                     RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1566:           end),
 1567:     Results = collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, []),
 1568:     Classified = [classify_race_submit(Result)
 1569:                   || {_Gateway, Result} <- Results],
 1570:     Evidences = [Ev || {accepted, Ev} <- Classified],
 1571:     %% A simultaneous second proof may be refused before durable custody while
 1572:     %% the first proof is still sealing. That refusal is safe because both
 1573:     %% gateways retain the exact same signed request and operation reference;
 1574:     %% after the first claim commits, either gateway must resolve it.
 1575:     ?assert(Evidences =/= []),
 1576:     [Evidence | _] = Evidences,
 1577:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 1578:     lists:foreach(
 1579:       fun(Ev) ->
 1580:           ?assertEqual(OperationRef, maps:get(operation_ref, Ev)),
 1581:           ?assertEqual(RequestBytes, maps:get(request_bytes, Ev)),
 1582:           ?assertEqual(Signature, maps:get(signature, Ev))
 1583:       end, Evidences),
 1584:     OutcomeRef = {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} =
 1585:         completed_remote_operation(Asker, OperationRef, 600),
 1586:     ?assertEqual(
 1587:        TargetAnchor,
 1588:        peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS])),
 1589:     ?assertMatch(
 1590:        {ok, #{status := claimed, operation_state := terminal,
 1591:               outcome_ref := {applications, [{transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _}]}}},
 1592:        peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])),
 1593:     ?assertMatch(
 1594:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 1595:                 #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := _},
 1596:                 #{status := completed,
 1597:                   targets := [{{?NS, TargetAnchor}, {committed, OutcomeRef}}]}}},
 1598:        wait_remote_operation(
 1599:          Asker, maps:get(session_id, AskerSession), RequestBytes,
 1600:          Signature, ClientPeer, 8)),
 1601:     {ok, #{status := committed, height := OutcomeHeight, ref := OutcomeRef}} =
 1602:         peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]),
 1603:     %% Third is an observer of the target ontology. A remote result at Asker
 1604:     %% does not mean Third's local projection has consumed the target block.
 1605:     %% Wait for that actual event; do not resubmit, nudge the feed, or replace
 1606:     %% the fixture's ordering requirement with a short repeated resolve loop.
 1607:     ok = peer:call(Third, quod_ct, await_applied,
 1608:                    [?NS, OutcomeHeight, 10000], 15000),
 1609:     ?assertMatch(
 1610:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 1611:                 #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := _},
 1612:                 #{status := completed,
 1613:                   targets := [{{?NS, TargetAnchor}, {committed, OutcomeRef}}]}}},
 1614:        peer:call(
 1615:          Third, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 1616:          [maps:get(session_id, ThirdSession), RequestBytes,
 1617:           Signature, ClientPeer], 10000)),
 1618:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_race_mark, Tag).
 1619: 
 1620: %% A signed agent stored in A reaches B and then C through the same nested
 1621: %% scope and group machinery. No specialized client or agent executor exists.
 1622: %% Real signed proofs use the same action evaluator locally at animals, on
 1623: %% its co-hosted fourth namespace, and remotely at third. The first candidate
 1624: %% crosses both boundaries, stages facts/events, cuts and fails. Only the
 1625: %% complete second candidate may reach any target ledger.
 1626: independent_action_multiscope_rollback(Config) ->
 1627:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1628:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1629:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1630:       "animals::(assertz((action_bad(~B) :- "
 1631:       "assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B)), "
 1632:       "fourth::(assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B))), "
 1633:       "third::(assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B))), !, fail)), "
 1634:       "assertz((action_good(~B) :- assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B)), "
 1635:       "fourth::(assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B))), "
 1636:       "third::(assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B))))), "
 1637:       "assertz(action(action_bad(~B), [], action_done(~B))), "
 1638:       "assertz(action(action_good(~B), [], action_done(~B)))).", lists:duplicate(18, Tag))),
 1639:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1640:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("animals::independent(goal(action_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1641:     {ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, Rows}}}} =
 1642:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1643:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1644:     ?assertEqual([?NS, ?FOURTH_NS, ?THIRD_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1645:     Owners = #{?NS => ?config(target, Config), ?FOURTH_NS => ?config(target, Config),
 1646:                ?THIRD_NS => ?config(third, Config)},
 1647:     lists:foreach(fun({{Ns, _}, {committed, {transaction, Ns, _, Id}}}) ->
 1648:         Peer = maps:get(Ns, Owners),
 1649:         assert_fact_once(Peer, Ns, action_done, Tag),
 1650:         assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, action_leak, Tag),
 1651:         Changes = peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, action_application_changes, [Ns, Id]),
 1652:         ?assertEqual([{action_done, Tag}], [E || {event, E} <- Changes])
 1653:     end, Rows).
 1654: 
 1655: independent_action_remote_errors(Config) ->
 1656:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1657:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1658:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1659:       "animals::(assertz((action_error(~B) :- assertz(action_error_leak(~B)), "
 1660:       "third::(assertz(action_error_leak(~B)), assertz(true)))), "
 1661:       "assertz(action(action_error(~B), [], action_error_done(~B)))).", lists:duplicate(5, Tag))),
 1662:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1663:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("animals::independent(goal(action_error_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1664:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1665:     Capture = peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, start_action_error_capture, []),
 1666:     {Result, Errors} = try
 1667:         {submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1668:          peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, finish_action_error_capture, [Capture])}
 1669:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
 1670:         peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, finish_action_error_capture, [Capture]),
 1671:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
 1672:     end,
 1673:     %% Public normalization deliberately hides language descriptors. Pin the
 1674:     %% original error at the real worker return, then the unchanged public form.
 1675:     ?assert(lists:member({permission_error, modify, static_procedure, {'/', true, 0}}, Errors)),
 1676:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {error, proof_unavailable}}}, Result),
 1677:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
 1678:         assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, action_error_leak, Tag)
 1679:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
 1680: 
 1681: start_action_error_capture() ->
 1682:     Pid = spawn(fun() -> action_error_capture([], none) end),
 1683:     1 = erlang:trace_pattern({quod_proof_scope, next, 1}, [{'_', [], [{return_trace}]}], [local]),
 1684:     _ = erlang:trace(all, true, [call, {tracer, Pid}]),
 1685:     Pid.
 1686: 
 1687: finish_action_error_capture(Pid) ->
 1688:     _ = erlang:trace(all, false, [call]),
 1689:     _ = erlang:trace_pattern({quod_proof_scope, next, 1}, false, [local]),
 1690:     Ref = make_ref(), Pid ! {finish, self(), Ref},
 1691:     receive {Ref, Errors} -> Errors after 5000 -> erlang:error(action_trace_timeout) end.
 1692: 
 1693: action_error_capture(Errors, Closing) ->
 1694:     receive
 1695:         {trace, _, return_from, {quod_proof_scope, next, 1},
 1696:          {error, {erlog, Reason}, _, _}} ->
 1697:             true = length(Errors) < 16,
 1698:             action_error_capture([Reason | Errors], Closing);
 1699:         {finish, Caller, Ref} ->
 1700:             Delivery = erlang:trace_delivered(all),
 1701:             action_error_capture(Errors, {Caller, Ref, Delivery});
 1702:         {trace_delivered, all, Delivery} ->
 1703:             {Caller, Ref, Delivery} = Closing, Caller ! {Ref, Errors};
 1704:         _ -> action_error_capture(Errors, Closing)
 1705:     end.
 1706: 
 1707: action_application_changes(Ns, TxId) ->
 1708:     {ok, #{snapshot := Snapshot, slot := Height}} =
 1709:         quod_simplex:history_view(Ns, any, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1710:     {ok, Store} = quod_ledger_store:open_ro_snapshot(Snapshot),
 1711:     try
 1712:         [Changes] = quod_ledger_store:fold(Store, 1, Height,
 1713:           fun(Entry, Acc) ->
 1714:               case quod_ledger:entry_view(Entry) of
 1715:                   #entry{data = {batch, Txs}} ->
 1716:                       [Diff || #transaction{tx_id = Id, diff = Diff} <- Txs,
 1717:                                Id =:= TxId] ++ Acc;
 1718:                   _ -> Acc
 1719:               end
 1720:           end, []),
 1721:         Changes
 1722:     after quod_ledger_store:close(Store)
 1723:     end.
 1724: 
 1725: %% Root's governed create_ontology bridge uses the same action evaluator and
 1726: %% its private savepoint. The other target writes ordinary facts; Root remains
 1727: %% effect-only, and exact durable claim redelivery cannot repeat the effect.
 1728: independent_action_remote_prepared_rollback(Config) ->
 1729:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1730:     Discarded = iolist_to_binary(["ct:action-discarded-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1731:     Kept = iolist_to_binary(["ct:action-kept-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1732:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1733:       "(assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1734:       "assertz((action_effect_bad(~B) :- \"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", [], _), !, fail)), "
 1735:       "assertz((action_effect_good(~B) :- \"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", [], _), assertz(action_effect_done(~B)))), "
 1736:       "assertz(action(action_effect_bad(~B), [], action_effect_done(~B))), "
 1737:       "assertz(action(action_effect_good(~B), [], action_effect_done(~B)))).",
 1738:       [Tag, Tag, Discarded, Tag, Kept, Tag, Tag, Tag, Tag, Tag])),
 1739:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1740:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("independent(goal(action_effect_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1741:     {ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1742:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1743:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1744:     ?assertEqual([?ASKER_NS, ?ROOT_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1745:     Target = ?config(target, Config), Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1746:     ?assertEqual({ok, not_hosted}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Discarded])),
 1747:     ?assertEqual({ok, ready}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Kept])),
 1748:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, action_effect_done, Tag),
 1749:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?ASKER_NS => Asker, ?ROOT_NS => Target}),
 1750:     ?assertEqual({ok, not_hosted}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Discarded])).
 1751: 
 1752: remote_independent_root_effect(Config) ->
 1753:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1754:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1755:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(["ct:s8-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1756:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1757:       "independent((assertz(s8_effect_mark(~B)), "
 1758:       "\"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", "
 1759:       "[source(\"can_invoke(_, _, _, _).\\n"
 1760:       "s8_effect_created(ok).\\n\")], _Anchor))).", [Tag, CreatedNs])),
 1761:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1762:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal),
 1763:     ?assertEqual(maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), Op),
 1764:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1765:     ?assertEqual([?ASKER_NS, ?ROOT_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1766:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s8_effect_mark, Tag),
 1767:     wait_ready(Target, CreatedNs, {s8_effect_created, ok}),
 1768:     Anchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [CreatedNs]),
 1769:     ?assertMatch(<<_:256>>, Anchor),
 1770:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?ASKER_NS => Asker, ?ROOT_NS => Target}),
 1771:     ?assertEqual(Anchor, peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [CreatedNs])),
 1772:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s8_effect_mark, Tag),
 1773:     #{included := Receipt} = peer:call(Asker, quod_ct, await_operation_complete,
 1774:                                       [?ASKER_NS, Op, 5000], 10000),
 1775:     ?assert(quod_operation_vector:certified(Receipt)).
 1776: 
 1777: remote_independent_routes(Config) ->
 1778:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1779:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1780:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}},
 1781:       submit_signed_execute(Config, <<"animals::independent(true).">>)),
 1782:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1783:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1784:       "animals::independent(assertz(s6_remote(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1785:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], Ref}}} =
 1786:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1787:     ?assertMatch({transaction, ?NS, _, _}, Ref),
 1788:     ?assertEqual(Ref, completed_remote_operation(
 1789:                        Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), 600)),
 1790:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, s6_remote, Tag),
 1791:     lists:foreach(fun(Goal) ->
 1792:         ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}},
 1793:                      submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal))
 1794:     end, [<<"independent((assertz(s6_ab), animals::assertz(s6_ab))).">>,
 1795:           <<"animals::independent((assertz(s6_bc), third::assertz(s6_bc))).">>]),
 1796:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns, Fact}) ->
 1797:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Fact]))
 1798:     end, [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s6_ab}, {Target, ?NS, s6_ab},
 1799:           {Target, ?NS, s6_bc}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_bc}]).
 1800: 
 1801: %% L2-S8-DEFERRED-7.4-ADMITTED-PARTIAL-OUTCOME: both plans are genuinely
 1802: %% sealed, then one target's read becomes stale before claim admission. The
 1803: %% shared applier rejects ONLY that target. No hand-built claim or bypass.
 1804: remote_independent_partial_outcome(Config) ->
 1805:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1806:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1807:     Third = ?config(third, Config), Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1808:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1809:       "animals::independent((diet(dog, kibble), assertz(s8_rejected(~B)), third::dtx_write(~B))).",
 1810:       [Tag, Tag])),
 1811:     ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1812:     Parent = self(), RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1813:     _ = spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal)} end),
 1814:     try
 1815:         ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1816:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove,
 1817:           [?NS, {assertz, {diet, dog, {s8_stale_marker, Tag}}}], 60000))
 1818:     after
 1819:         _ = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1820:     end,
 1821:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1822:         receive {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1823:         after 60000 -> ct:fail(independent_partial_outcome_timeout) end,
 1824:     ?assertEqual(maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), Op),
 1825:     ?assertEqual(mixed, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1826:     ?assertMatch([{{?NS, _}, {{rejected, conflict_retry}, _}},
 1827:                   {{?THIRD_NS, _}, {committed, _}}], Rows),
 1828:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, s8_rejected, Tag),
 1829:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 1830:     %% Repeat exact delivery after mixed completion: rejected A stays rejected,
 1831:     %% committed B stays exactly once, and neither gets a fresh application id.
 1832:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?NS => Target, ?THIRD_NS => Third}),
 1833:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, s8_rejected, Tag),
 1834:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 1835:     %% The source owner must recover the same complete vector for a later
 1836:     %% caller. A different gateway then verifies the source receipt and the
 1837:     %% exact AM3 target evidence; current-view status labels are insufficient.
 1838:     SessionId = maps:get(session_id, ?config(client_session, Config)),
 1839:     RequestBytes = maps:get(request_bytes, Evidence), Signature = maps:get(signature, Evidence),
 1840:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}},
 1841:       peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 1842:         [SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature, ?config(client_peer, Config)], 10000)),
 1843:     ForeignSession = open_client_session(Target, ?config(network_id, Config),
 1844:       ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config), ?config(client_peer, Config)),
 1845:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}},
 1846:       wait_remote_operation(Target, maps:get(session_id, ForeignSession), RequestBytes,
 1847:         Signature, ?config(client_peer, Config), 8)).
 1848: 
 1849: 
 1850: assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, Owners) ->
 1851:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1852:     {ok, #{height := Slot}} = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, local_outcome, [?ASKER_NS, Op]),
 1853:     Deadline = peer:call(Asker, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 1854:     {ok, ClaimRef, Claim} = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, operation_claim_evidence,
 1855:                                     [?ASKER_NS, Slot, Op, Deadline]),
 1856:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_transaction:encode_evidence(ClaimRef, Claim),
 1857:     lists:foreach(fun({Identity = {Ns, _}, {Verdict, Ref}}) ->
 1858:         Peer = maps:get(Ns, Owners),
 1859:         {transaction, _, _, TxId} = Ref,
 1860:         Before = peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences, [Ns, TxId]),
 1861:         ?assertMatch([_], Before),
 1862:         lists:foreach(fun(_) ->
 1863:             ?assertEqual({ok, Bytes}, quod_transaction:encode_evidence(ClaimRef, Claim)),
 1864:             Id = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), Request = {apply_claim, Id, Identity, Bytes},
 1865:             ?assertMatch({ok, {application, Id, Verdict, _}, _Hints}, peer:call(
 1866:               Asker, quod_dtx_current_view, submit_claim_application,
 1867:               [?ASKER_NS, Identity, Claim, Request, 5000], 10000)),
 1868:             ?assertEqual(Before, peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences, [Ns, TxId]))
 1869:         end, [first, second])
 1870:     end, Rows).
 1871: 
 1872: %% Positive atomic/reconnect cases establish their own route precondition. A prior
 1873: %% case may already have installed this exact fixture route; verify it then,
 1874: %% never erase it or rely on a particular suite order. Negative/recovery
 1875: %% route cases use the separately isolated read-set suite.
 1876: require_third_route_at_target(Config) ->
 1877:     Peer = ?config(target, Config), Key = ?config(third_pub, Config),
 1878:     Endpoint = ?config(third_addr, Config),
 1879:     Identity = {?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config)},
 1880:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, route_hints, [Identity, []]) of
 1881:         {error, unavailable} ->
 1882:             {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 1883:               [Key, Endpoint, [{?THIRD_NS, element(2, Identity), validator}], 1, 1]);
 1884:         {ok, _} -> ok
 1885:     end,
 1886:     {ok, Routes} = peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, route_hints, [Identity, []]),
 1887:     {Key, Endpoints} = lists:keyfind(Key, 1, Routes),
 1888:     ?assert(lists:member(Endpoint, Endpoints)),
 1889:     ok.
 1890: 
 1891: remote_independent_branch_provenance(Config) ->
 1892:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1893:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1894:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1895:     %% The original signed request and real sealed retained writes choose L3.
 1896:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
 1897:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1898:         <<"animals::((independent((assertz(s6_f1), third::assertz(s6_f1), fail))); true).">>)),
 1899:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{}], _},
 1900:                  peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, s6_f1])),
 1901:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, s6_f1])),
 1902:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {error, independent_mixed_writes}}},
 1903:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1904:         <<"animals::(((assertz(s6_f2), fail); true), independent(third::assertz(s6_f2))).">>)),
 1905:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}},
 1906:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1907:         <<"animals::((independent((assertz(s6_f3), fail)); true), independent(third::assertz(s6_f3))).">>)),
 1908:     %% A remotely-produced successful marker must unwind at its caller too.
 1909:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
 1910:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1911:         <<"((animals::independent((assertz(s6_unwound), third::assertz(s6_unwound))), fail); true).">>)),
 1912:     lists:foreach(fun(Fact) ->
 1913:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, Fact])),
 1914:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, Fact]))
 1915:     end, [s6_f2]),
 1916:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, s6_f3])),
 1917:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, s6_f3])).

 1919: remote_independent_nesting_and_auth(Config) ->
 1920:     lists:foreach(fun(Text) ->
 1921:         ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {error, independent_nesting}}},
 1922:                      submit_signed_execute(Config, Text))
 1923:     end, [<<"animals::independent(third::transaction(true)).">>,
 1924:           <<"animals::transaction(third::independent(true)).">>,
 1925:           <<"animals::independent(third::independent(true)).">>,
 1926:           <<"animals::independent(third::(animals::transaction(true))).">>]),
 1927:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1928:     {Bytes, _Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1929:       ?config(network_id, Config), ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1930:       ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1931:       <<"animals::independent(assertz(s6_invalid_auth)).">>),
 1932:     ?assertEqual({error, invalid_signature}, peer:call(

 1934:       [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes, <<0:512>>, ?config(client_peer, Config)])),
 1935:     ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(
 1936:       ?config(target, Config), quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, s6_invalid_auth])).

 1938: remote_independent_cursor_selects_only_accepted_answer(Config) ->
 1939:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1940:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1941:     SessionId = maps:get(session_id, Session),
 1942:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1943:     lists:foreach(fun(AcceptSecond) ->
 1944:         Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1945:         Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1946:           "animals::((independent((assertz(s6_cursor(~B)), third::assertz(s6_cursor(~B)))), X=first); X=second).",
 1947:           [Tag, Tag])),
 1948:         {Bytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1949:           ?config(network_id, Config), ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1950:           ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), maps:get(expires_ms, Session), cursor, Text),
 1951:         {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, First}}} = peer:call(
 1952:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1953:           [cursor, SessionId, Bytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1954:         ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, first}]}, quod_durable_term:decode_result(First)),
 1955:         case AcceptSecond of
 1956:             false -> ok;
 1957:             true ->
 1958:                 {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, Second}}} = peer:call(
 1959:                   Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1960:                   [SessionId, CursorId, next, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1961:                 ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, second}]},
 1962:                              quod_durable_term:decode_result(Second))
 1963:         end,
 1964:         Result = peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1965:                           [SessionId, CursorId, accept, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1966:         case AcceptSecond of
 1967:             false ->
 1968:                 ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized,
 1969:                              {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}}, Result),
 1970:                 assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, s6_cursor, Tag),
 1971:                 assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_cursor, Tag);
 1972:             true ->
 1973:                 ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized,
 1974:                                      {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}}, Result),
 1975:                 assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, s6_cursor, Tag),
 1976:                 assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_cursor, Tag)
 1977:         end
 1978:     end, [false, true]).

 1980: remote_signed_gateway_group(Config) ->
 1981:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1982:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1983:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1984:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1985:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1986:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1987:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1988:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1989: 
 1990:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1991:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1992:     %% Third already received Target's exact current record in suite setup.
 1993:     %% Reinstalling sequence 1 here would correctly be rejected as stale.
 1994:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1995:     GroupText = iolist_to_binary(
 1996:                   io_lib:format(
 1997:                     "\"animals\"::dtx_write_chain(~B).", [Tag])),
 1998:     {GroupBytes, GroupSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1999:                                      NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2000:                                      ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2001:                                      maps:get(expires_ms, Session), execute,
 2002:                                      GroupText),
 2003:     {ok, GroupEvidence,
 2004:      {normalized,
 2005:       {committed, [_],
 2006:        {group_outcome,
 2007:         {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _} = GroupRef,
 2008:         _, Slots}}}} =
 2009:         peer:call(
 2010:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2011:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), GroupBytes,
 2012:            GroupSignature, Peer], 60000),
 2013:     %% O participates even when both writable scopes are remote.
 2014:     ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 2015:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 2016:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2017:     ?assertMatch(
 2018:        {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef}},
 2019:        peer:call(
 2020:          Asker, quod_prolog, outcome,
 2021:          [maps:get(operation_ref, GroupEvidence)])),
 2022:     ok.

 2024: %% Eight independently signed, non-conflicting A -> B -> C writes enter
 2025: %% together. Each writes distinct predicate heads on B and C, so this exercises
 2026: %% the conflict-safe batch path rather than the separate wait-die abort test
 2027: %% below. The old single handoff slot rejected this shape as busy.
 2028: remote_signed_concurrent_gateway_groups(Config) ->
 2029:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 2030:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2031:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2032:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2033:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2034:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2035:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2036:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2037:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2038:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2039:     PredicateRows = dtx_disjoint_predicates(),
 2040:     Requests =
 2041:         [begin
 2042:              Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2043:              GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 2044:                           io_lib:format(
 2045:                             "\"animals\"::~s(~B).",
 2046:                             [atom_to_list(ChainPredicate), Tag])),
 2047:              {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2048:                                            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2049:                                            ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2050:                                            maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 2051:                                            execute, GoalText),
 2052:              {Index, Tag, LocalPredicate, RemotePredicate,
 2053:               RequestBytes, Signature}
 2054:          end || {Index, {ChainPredicate, LocalPredicate,
 2055:                          _RemoteWriter, RemotePredicate}} <-
 2056:                     lists:zip(lists:seq(1, 8), PredicateRows)],
 2057:     Parent = self(),
 2058:     ConcurrentRef = make_ref(),
 2059:     Writers =
 2060:         [spawn(
 2061:            fun() ->
 2062:                receive {ConcurrentRef, go} -> ok end,
 2063:                Result = peer:call(
 2064:                           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2065:                           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session),
 2066:                            RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 2067:                Parent ! {ConcurrentRef, Index, Result}
 2068:            end)
 2069:          || {Index, _Tag, _LocalPredicate, _RemotePredicate,
 2070:              RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 2071:     lists:foreach(fun(Pid) -> Pid ! {ConcurrentRef, go} end, Writers),
 2072:     Results = collect_gateway_race(ConcurrentRef, length(Requests), []),
 2073:     EvidenceByIndex =
 2074:         maps:from_list(
 2075:           [{Index, concurrent_submit_evidence(Index, Result)}
 2076:            || {Index, Result} <- Results]),
 2077:     OperationRefs =
 2078:         [maps:get(operation_ref, maps:get(Index, EvidenceByIndex))
 2079:          || {Index, _Tag, _LocalPredicate, _RemotePredicate,
 2080:              _RequestBytes, _Signature} <- Requests],
 2081:     ?assertEqual(length(Requests), length(lists:usort(OperationRefs))),
 2082:     lists:foreach(
 2083:       fun({Index, Tag, LocalPredicate, RemotePredicate,
 2084:            _RequestBytes, _Signature}) ->
 2085:           OperationRef = maps:get(
 2086:                            operation_ref, maps:get(Index, EvidenceByIndex)),
 2087:           {#{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef},
 2088:            #{status := committed, participant_slots := Slots}} =
 2089:               wait_operation_claim(Asker, OperationRef, 600),
 2090:           ?assertMatch(
 2091:              {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _}, GroupRef),
 2092:           ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 2093:           assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, LocalPredicate, Tag),
 2094:           assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, RemotePredicate, Tag)
 2095:       end, Requests),
 2096:     Stats = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, stats, [?ASKER_NS]),
 2097:     ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(dtx_admission_waiting, Stats)),
 2098:     ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(dtx_admission_dormant, Stats)),
 2099:     ok.

 2101: %% Both proofs read conflict_version/1 while it is zero, then wait at the
 2102: %% pre-Vote FIFO seam. One group changes that fact; the other must retain its
 2103: %% claimed operation id and terminate with the ordinary stale-read abort.
 2104: remote_signed_queued_occ_abort(Config) ->
 2105:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2106:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2107:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2108:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2109:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2110:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2111:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2112:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2113:     Session = open_client_session(
 2114:                 Asker, NetworkId, ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 2115:                 AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 2116:     Requests =
 2117:         [begin
 2118:              Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2119:              GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 2120:                           io_lib:format(
 2121:                             "\"animals\"::dtx_conflicting_write(~B).",
 2122:                             [Tag])),
 2123:              {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2124:                                            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2125:                                            ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2126:                                            maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 2127:                                            execute, GoalText),
 2128:              {Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature}
 2129:          end || Index <- [1, 2]],
 2130:     Parent = self(),
 2131:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 2132:     Writers =
 2133:         [spawn(
 2134:            fun() ->
 2135:                receive {RaceRef, go} -> ok end,
 2136:                Result = peer:call(
 2137:                           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2138:                           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session),
 2139:                            RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 2140:                Parent ! {RaceRef, Index, Result}
 2141:            end)
 2142:          || {Index, _Tag, RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 2143:     lists:foreach(fun(Pid) -> Pid ! {RaceRef, go} end, Writers),
 2144:     Evidences = maps:from_list(
 2145:                   [{Index, concurrent_conflict_evidence(Index, Result)}
 2146:                    || {Index, Result} <-
 2147:                           collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, [])]),
 2148:     Outcomes =
 2149:         [{Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2150:           wait_operation_terminal(
 2151:             Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, maps:get(Index, Evidences)), 600)}
 2152:          || {Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 2153:     [{CommittedIndex, CommittedTag, _CommittedBytes, _CommittedSignature,
 2154:       {_, #{status := committed}}}] =
 2155:         [Row || Row = {_, _, _, _, {_, #{status := committed}}} <- Outcomes],
 2156:     [{AbortedIndex, AbortedTag, AbortedBytes, AbortedSignature,
 2157:       {#{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}}] =
 2158:         [Row || Row = {_, _, _, _,
 2159:                        {#{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}} <- Outcomes],
 2160:     ?assertNotEqual(CommittedIndex, AbortedIndex),
 2161:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_conflict_mark, CommittedTag),
 2162:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, dtx_conflict_mark, AbortedTag),
 2163:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, CommittedTag),
 2164:     ?assertMatch(
 2165:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 2166:                 #{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}},
 2167:        wait_remote_operation(
 2168:          Asker, maps:get(session_id, Session), AbortedBytes,
 2169:          AbortedSignature, ClientPeer, 8)),
 2170:     ok.

 2172: %% One signed proof writes its agent ontology and stages Root's existing
 2173: %% create-ontology effect.  Root is hosted on another peer, so this exercises
 2174: %% the real scope custody command, not only the co-hosted session path.
 2175: remote_signed_gateway_group_with_root_effect(Config) ->
 2176:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2177:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2178:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2179:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2180:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2181:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2182:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2183:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2184:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2185:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(
 2186:                   ["ct:remote-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 2187:     GoalText = root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs),
 2188:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2189:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2190:                                   ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2191:                                   maps:get(expires_ms, Session), execute,
 2192:                                   GoalText),
 2193:     {ok, _Evidence,
 2194:      {normalized,
 2195:       {committed, [_],
 2196:        {group_outcome,
 2197:         {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _} = GroupRef,
 2198:         _, Slots}}}} =
 2199:         peer:call(
 2200:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2201:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), RequestBytes,
 2202:            Signature, Peer], 60000),
 2203:     ?assertEqual(2, length(Slots)),
 2204:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2205:     %% Group application records the effect obligation; the existing effect
 2206:     %% owner starts the ontology asynchronously. Observe its completion before
 2207:     %% asking the new ontology to prove a goal.
 2208:     wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, applied, 300),
 2209:     wait_ready(Target, CreatedNs, {remote_effect_created, ok}),
 2210:     ok.
 2211: 
 2212: root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs) ->
 2213:     iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 2214:       "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 2215:       "\"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", "
 2216:       "[source(\"can_invoke(_, _, _, _).\\n"
 2217:       "remote_effect_created(ok).\\n\")], _Anchor).", [Tag, CreatedNs])).
 2218: 
 2219: %% A real remote effect is durably bound, but the source never activates.
 2220: %% OTP's installed debug callback holds the existing activation call before
 2221: %% handle_call, without a production hook or a send/receipt ordering guess.
 2222: remote_bound_effect_recovers_without_activation(Config) ->
 2223:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2224:     OldEngine = peer:call(Asker, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2225:     OldSimplex = peer:call(Asker, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2226:     Gate = {?MODULE, before_activation},
 2227:     ok = peer:call(Asker, sys, install,
 2228:                    [OldEngine, {Gate, fun ?MODULE:hold_group_activation/3, armed}]),
 2229:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2230:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(["ct:aborted-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 2231:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2232:     %% Choose the request's original bound once; never extend it after failure.
 2233:     Expires = min(maps:get(expires_ms, Session), quod_time:now_ms() + 10000),
 2234:     {Bytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2235:       ?config(network_id, Config), ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2236:       ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), Expires, execute,
 2237:       root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs)),
 2238:     Parent = self(), CallRef = make_ref(), ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2239:     spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {CallRef, peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress,
 2240:       submit, [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)} end),
 2241:     try
 2242:         {GroupRef, _Token} = wait_activation_gate(Asker, CallRef, 300),
 2243:         wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, group_pending, 50),
 2244:         {running, OwnerState} = peer:call(Asker, sys, get_state, [OldSimplex]),
 2245:         ?assertMatch(#{active := 0, reserved := 1}, peer:call(
 2246:           Asker, quod_simplex, test_dtx_admission_state, [OwnerState])),
 2247:         Journal = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, test_signing_journal, [OwnerState]),
 2248:         {group, _, _, _, _, Id} = GroupRef,
 2249:         #{Id := #{sequence := 0, envelope := none,
 2250:                   material := {{quod_dtx_vote, 4, Group, _, none, _}, _, _}}} =
 2251:             peer:call(Asker, quod_signing_journal, pending_dtx, [Journal]),
 2252:         %% Source responsibility already retains the exact original request,
 2253:         %% before activation or any source Vote. It is not just a generated
 2254:         %% operation ID that a later hosted incarnation would have to recreate.
 2255:         Digest = crypto:hash(sha256,Bytes),
 2256:         ?assertMatch({quod_atomic_group,4,_,{agent_goal_v1,Digest,Bytes,Signature},_},Group),
 2257:         {ok,#{request := #{evidence := #{agent_ref_blob := AgentBytes}}}} =
 2258:             peer:call(Asker,quod_atomic,group_binding,[Group]),
 2259:         ?assertEqual(#{Id => true},peer:call(Asker,?MODULE,agent_custody_snapshot,[OldSimplex,AgentBytes])),
 2260:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldEngine, kill]),
 2261:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldSimplex, kill]),
 2262:         receive {CallRef, Result} ->
 2263:             ?assertNotMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, _, _}}}, Result)
 2264:         after 10000 -> ct:fail(bound_effect_caller_did_not_observe_crash)
 2265:         end,
 2266:         wait_restarted(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, OldSimplex, 400),
 2267:         ?assertMatch(#{status := aborted, ref := GroupRef},
 2268:                      wait_group_outcome(Asker, GroupRef, 600)),
 2269:         wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, retired, 300),
 2270:         assert_fact_absent(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2271:         ?assertEqual(undefined, peer:call(Target, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, CreatedNs}])),
 2272:         assert_dtx_released(Asker, ?ASKER_NS),
 2273:         assert_dtx_released(Target, ?ROOT_NS)
 2274:     after
 2275:         %% Release only this test gate if setup failed before the injected kill.
 2276:         case peer:call(Asker, application, get_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate]) of
 2277:             {ok, {_Ref, Release}} -> peer:call(Asker, erlang, send, [OldEngine, {release, Release}]);
 2278:             _ -> ok
 2279:         end,
 2280:         _ = catch peer:call(Asker, sys, remove, [OldEngine, Gate]),
 2281:         _ = peer:call(Asker, application, unset_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate])
 2282:     end.

 2284: agent_custody_snapshot(Owner, Agent) ->
 2285:     Token = make_ref(), Monitor = monitor(process,Owner),
 2286:     Owner ! {agent_work_custody,self(),Token,Agent,all},
 2287:     try receive
 2288:         {agent_work_custody,Owner,Token,Rows} -> Rows;
 2289:         {'DOWN',Monitor,process,Owner,Reason} -> error({custody_owner_down,Reason})
 2290:     after 5000 -> error(custody_snapshot_missing)
 2291:     end after demonitor(Monitor,[flush]) end.

 2293: hold_group_activation(armed, {in, {'$gen_call', _, {activate_dtx_vote, _, GroupRef}}}, _) ->
 2294:     Token = make_ref(),
 2295:     ok = application:set_env(quod, ct_activation_gate, {GroupRef, Token}),
 2296:     receive {release, Token} -> ok after 15000 -> ok end,
 2297:     done;
 2298: hold_group_activation(State, _Event, _Name) -> State.
 2299: 
 2300: wait_activation_gate(_Peer, _CallRef, 0) -> ct:fail(activation_gate_timeout);
 2301: wait_activation_gate(Peer, CallRef, Retries) ->
 2302:     case peer:call(Peer, application, get_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate]) of
 2303:         {ok, {_, _} = Held} -> Held;
 2304:         _ ->
 2305:             receive {CallRef, Result} -> ct:fail({proof_ended_before_activation, Result})
 2306:             after 20 -> wait_activation_gate(Peer, CallRef, Retries - 1)
 2307:             end
 2308:     end.

 2310: %% One browser-equivalent request crosses two remote scope hops and commits
 2311: %% through the ordinary group protocol.
 2312: remote_signed_group_uses_exact_agent_request(Config) ->
 2313:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2314:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2315:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2316:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2317:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2318:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2319:     Anchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2320:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2321:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 2322:                  io_lib:format(
 2323:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 2324:                    "\"animals\"::dtx_write_chain(~B).",
 2325:                    [Tag, Tag])),
 2326:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2327:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2328:                                   ?ASKER_NS, Anchor,
 2329:                                   maps:get(expires_ms, Session), GoalText),
 2330:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, SubmitResult}} = peer:call(
 2331:                                                    Asker,
 2332:                                                    quod_client_goal_ingress,
 2333:                                                    submit,
 2334:                                                    [execute,
 2335:                                                     maps:get(session_id,
 2336:                                                              Session),
 2337:                                                     RequestBytes, Signature,
 2338:                                                     Peer],
 2339:                                                    60000),
 2340:     {GroupRef, Outcome} =
 2341:         case SubmitResult of
 2342:             {committed, [_],
 2343:              {group_outcome,
 2344:               {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor, _, _, _} = Ref,
 2345:               Height, ParticipantSlots}} ->
 2346:                 {Ref, #{status => committed, ref => Ref, height => Height,
 2347:                         participant_slots => ParticipantSlots}};
 2348:             {pending, {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor, _, _, _} = Ref} ->
 2349:                 %% A transport timeout is uncertainty, never permission to
 2350:                 %% resubmit. Resolve the exact first group instead.
 2351:                 {Ref, wait_group_outcome(Asker, Ref, 600)}
 2352:         end,
 2353:     Slots = maps:get(participant_slots, Outcome),
 2354:     ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 2355:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2356:     assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 2357:     assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2358:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 2359:     ?assertMatch(
 2360:        {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef}},
 2361:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])).
