 2363: %% The origin is stopped after the remote Vote wave, before any Resolve.
 2364: %% Recovery uses certified own-role material, never a re-proof or another
 2365: %% role's plan. The exact caller reference still finds the one terminal result.
 2366: remote_group_recovers_after_origin_crash(Config) ->
 2367:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 2368:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2369:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2370:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2371:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2372:     Goal = {',', {assertz, {dtx_pets_mark, Tag}},
 2373:                  {'::', ?NS, {dtx_write_chain, Tag}}},
 2374:     VotePhase = {voted, {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config)}},
 2375:     ok = peer:call(
 2376:            Asker, application, set_env,
 2377:            [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier, {hold, VotePhase}]),
 2378:     ?assertEqual(
 2379:        {ok, {hold, VotePhase}},
 2380:        peer:call(Asker, application, get_env,
 2381:                  [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])),
 2382:     Parent = self(),
 2383:     ProofRef = make_ref(),
 2384:     _ProofCaller = spawn(
 2385:                      fun() ->
 2386:                          Result = peer:call(
 2387:                                     Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 2388:                                     [?ASKER_NS, Goal], 60000),
 2389:                          Parent ! {ProofRef, Result}
 2390:                      end),
 2391:     try
 2392:         GroupId = wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, VotePhase, Config),
 2393:         %% No role has applied; each one's exact positive Vote must already
 2394:         %% be certified, making commit the only possible recovered outcome.
 2395:         lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
 2396:             assert_prepared_vote(Peer, Ns, GroupId),
 2397:             assert_resolve_absent(Peer, Ns, GroupId)
 2398:         end, [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS}, {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]),
 2399:         {ok, {?ASKER_NS, Anchor, Coordinator, Admission}} =
 2400:             peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, dtx_binding, [?ASKER_NS]),
 2401:         GroupRef = {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor,
 2402:                     Coordinator, Admission, GroupId},
 2403:         OldSimplex = peer:call(
 2404:                        Asker, quod_reg, where,
 2405:                        [{quod_simplex, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2406:         true = is_pid(OldSimplex),
 2407:         %% The bounded test valve must still be holding the coordinator at
 2408:         %% the Vote wave. Otherwise a slow test could silently crash after a
 2409:         %% self-released gate and prove only a weaker recovery path.
 2410:         ?assertMatch(
 2411:            {ok, {held, GroupId, VotePhase, _}},
 2412:            peer:call(Asker, application, get_env,
 2413:                      [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])),
 2414:         %% Disable the one-shot barrier before restart: the replacement
 2415:         %% coordinator must be free to rediscover the Votes and continue.
 2416:         ok = peer:call(
 2417:                Asker, application, unset_env,
 2418:                [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier]),
 2419:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldSimplex, kill]),
 2420:         ?assertEqual(
 2421:            {error, {outcome_unknown, GroupRef}},
 2422:            receive
 2423:                {ProofRef, ProofResult} -> ProofResult
 2424:            after 10000 ->
 2425:                ct:fail(proof_caller_did_not_observe_origin_crash)
 2426:            end),
 2427:         wait_restarted(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, OldSimplex, 400),
 2428:         Outcome = wait_group_outcome(Asker, GroupRef, 600),
 2429:         ?assertMatch(
 2430:            #{status := committed, ref := GroupRef,
 2431:              participant_slots := [_, _, _]}, Outcome),
 2432:         assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, dtx_pets_mark, Tag),
 2433:         assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 2434:         assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2435:         lists:foreach(
 2436:           fun({Peer, Ns}) -> assert_dtx_released(Peer, Ns) end,
 2437:           [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS}, {Third, ?THIRD_NS}])
 2438:     after
 2439:         _ = peer:call(
 2440:               Asker, application, unset_env,
 2441:               [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])
 2442:     end.
 2443: 
 2444: %% A route consumer knows the certified identities but starts with no live
 2445: %% route rows.  Each missing hop parks on the one exact directory property;
 2446: %% installing the ordinary complete generation wakes that same proof.  Four
 2447: %% ontology scopes are involved even though B and D share one physical node.
 2448: remote_four_scope_chain_recovers_empty_routes(Config) ->
 2449:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2450:     TargetIdentity = {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config)},
 2451:     ThirdIdentity = {?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config)},
 2452:     Before = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory_control, stats, []),
 2453:     ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, expire, [1 bsl 60]),
 2454:     ?assertEqual(
 2455:        {known, []}, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS])),
 2456:     ?assertEqual(
 2457:        {known, []}, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?THIRD_NS])),
 2458:     Parent = self(),
 2459:     ProofRef = make_ref(),
 2460:     _Caller = spawn(
 2461:                 fun() ->
 2462:                     Result = peer:call(
 2463:                                Asker, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
 2464:                                [?ASKER_NS,
 2465:                                 {'::', ?NS, {via_fourth, {'X'}}}],
 2466:                                60000),
 2467:                     Parent ! {ProofRef, Result}
 2468:                 end),
 2469:     try
 2470:         ok = wait_route_demand(Asker, TargetIdentity, 500),
 2471:         ok = install_chain_target_generation(Config, 2),
 2472:         ok = wait_route_demand(Asker, ThirdIdentity, 500),
 2473:         ok = install_chain_third_generation(Config, 2),
 2474:         ?assertMatch(
 2475:            {ok, [#{'X' := _}], _},
 2476:            receive
 2477:                {ProofRef, ProofResult} -> ProofResult
 2478:            after 10000 ->
 2479:                ct:fail(four_scope_route_wake_timeout)
 2480:            end),
 2481:         After = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory_control, stats, []),
 2482:         ?assert(maps:get(route_demanded, After) >=
 2483:                     maps:get(route_demanded, Before) + 2),
 2484:         ?assert(maps:get(route_wakes, After) >=
 2485:                     maps:get(route_wakes, Before) + 2)
 2486:     after
 2487:         %% Restore complete generations even if the assertion failed so this
 2488:         %% suite never leaves a hidden route dependency for later cleanup.
 2489:         _ = install_chain_target_generation(Config, 3),
 2490:         _ = install_chain_third_generation(Config, 3)
 2491:     end.
 2492: 
 2493: wait_route_demand(_Peer, Identity, 0) ->
 2494:     ct:fail({route_demand_timeout, Identity});
 2495: wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries) ->
 2496:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []) of
 2497:         #{route_demands := Demands} ->
 2498:             case lists:member(Identity, Demands) of
 2499:                 true -> ok;
 2500:                 false ->
 2501:                     timer:sleep(10),
 2502:                     wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries - 1)
 2503:             end;
 2504:         _ ->
 2505:             timer:sleep(10),
 2506:             wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries - 1)
 2507:     end.
 2508: 
 2509: install_chain_target_generation(Config, Epoch) ->
 2510:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2511:     case peer:call(
 2512:            Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 2513:            [?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
 2514:             [{?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config), validator},
 2515:              {?FOURTH_NS, ?config(fourth_anchor, Config), validator},
 2516:              {?ROOT_NS, ?config(network_id, Config), validator}],
 2517:             Epoch, 1]) of
 2518:         {ok, _} -> ok;
 2519:         Other -> Other
 2520:     end.
 2521: 
 2522: install_chain_third_generation(Config, Epoch) ->
 2523:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2524:     case peer:call(
 2525:            Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 2526:            [?config(third_pub, Config), ?config(third_addr, Config),
 2527:             [{?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config), validator},
 2528:              {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config), observer}],
 2529:             Epoch, 1]) of
 2530:         {ok, _} -> ok;
 2531:         Other -> Other
 2532:     end.
 2533: 
 2534: wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config) ->
 2535:     wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, 300).
 2536: 
 2537: wait_vote_barrier(_ProofRef, _Phase, Config, 0) ->
 2538:     ct:fail({dtx_vote_barrier_timeout, dtx_diagnostics(Config)});
 2539: wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, Retries) ->
 2540:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2541:     case peer:call(
 2542:            Asker, application, get_env,
 2543:            [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier]) of
 2544:         {ok, {held, <<_:256>> = GroupId, Phase, _BarrierRef}} ->
 2545:             %% The gate is before the next planner drive, not a timed guess.
 2546:             GroupId;
 2547:         _ ->
 2548:             receive
 2549:                 {ProofRef, ProofResult} ->
 2550:                     ct:fail({group_proof_ended_before_vote, ProofResult})
 2551:             after 0 ->
 2552:                 timer:sleep(50),
 2553:                 wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, Retries - 1)
 2554:             end
 2555:     end.
 2556: 
 2557: assert_prepared_vote(Peer, Ns, GroupId) ->
 2558:     Request = {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), GroupId, vote},
 2559:     {ok, {phase, _, _, {committed, Ref}}, _} = peer:call(
 2560:         Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local, [Ns, Request, [], 1000]),
 2561:     {ok, Identity, _, _} = quod_dtx:certified_ref_binding(Ref),
 2562:     Deadline = peer:call(Peer, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 2563:     {ok, #{control := Control}} = peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log,
 2564:         resolve_reference, [Identity, Ref, vote, none, none, Deadline]),
 2565:     ?assertMatch({quod_dtx_vote, 4, _, _, _, prepared},
 2566:                  quod_atomic:control_body(Control)).
 2567: 
 2568: assert_resolve_absent(Peer, Ns, GroupId) ->
 2569:     Request = {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), GroupId, resolve},
 2570:     ?assertMatch(
 2571:        {ok, {phase, _, _, not_found}, []},
 2572:        peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local,
 2573:                  [Ns, Request, [], 1000])).
 2574: 
 2575: wait_remote_effect_state(_Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, 0) ->
 2576:     ct:fail({effect_state_timeout, Ns, GroupRef, Expected});
 2577: wait_remote_effect_state(Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, Retries) ->
 2578:     Rows = peer:call(Peer, quod_effect_journal, rows, []),
 2579:     case [State || #{target := {RowNs, _}, ref := RowRef,
 2580:                      state := State} <- Rows,
 2581:                    RowNs =:= Ns,
 2582:                    element(1, RowRef) =:= group_effect,
 2583:                    element(3, RowRef) =:= GroupRef] of
 2584:         [Expected] -> ok;
 2585:         _ ->
 2586:             timer:sleep(20),
 2587:             wait_remote_effect_state(
 2588:               Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, Retries - 1)
 2589:     end.

 2591: dtx_diagnostics(Config) ->
 2592:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2593:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2594:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2595:     Statuses =
 2596:         [{Ns, peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [Ns])}
 2597:          || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2598:                            {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]],
 2599:     GroupId =
 2600:         case proplists:get_value(?ASKER_NS, Statuses, #{}) of
 2601:             #{dtx_coordinators := Coordinators} ->
 2602:                 single_coordinator_id(Coordinators);
 2603:             _ -> undefined
 2604:         end,
 2605:     AskerInternal = dtx_internal_diagnostics(Asker, ?ASKER_NS),
 2606:     Phases =
 2607:         case GroupId of
 2608:             <<_:256>> ->
 2609:                 [{Ns,
 2610:                   [{Kind,
 2611:                     peer:call(
 2612:                       Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local,
 2613:                       [Ns, {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16),
 2614:                             GroupId, Kind}, [], 1000])}
 2615:                    || Kind <- [vote, resolve, complete]]}
 2616:                  || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2617:                                    {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]];
 2618:             _ ->
 2619:                 []
 2620:         end,
 2621:     BVote = phase_result(?NS, Phases, vote),
 2622:     CVote = phase_result(?THIRD_NS, Phases, vote),
 2623:     RawBVerify = raw_vote_verify(
 2624:                    Asker, ?config(target_pub, Config),
 2625:                    ?config(target_addr, Config), BVote),
 2626:     RawCVerify = raw_vote_verify(
 2627:                    Asker, ?config(third_pub, Config),
 2628:                    ?config(third_addr, Config), CVote),
 2629:     #{statuses => Statuses, phases => Phases,
 2630:       asker_internal => AskerInternal,
 2631:       raw_b_vote_verify => RawBVerify,
 2632:       raw_c_vote_verify => RawCVerify,
 2633:       foreign_log_stats =>
 2634:           [{Ns, peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, stats, [])}
 2635:            || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2636:                              {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]],
 2637:       asker_routes =>
 2638:           [{Ns, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [Ns])}
 2639:            || Ns <- [?NS, ?THIRD_NS]],
 2640:       third_origin_routes =>
 2641:           peer:call(Third, quod_directory, validator_routes,
 2642:                     [?ASKER_NS,
 2643:                      peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, genesis_hash,
 2644:                                [?ASKER_NS])])}.
 2645: 
 2646: raw_vote_verify(
 2647:   Peer, Validator, Endpoint,
 2648:   {ok, {phase, _RequestId, _Generation, {committed, Ref}}, _}) ->
 2649:     peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, verify,
 2650:               [Validator, Endpoint, Ref, vote, 5000]);
 2651: raw_vote_verify(_Peer, _Validator, _Endpoint, _PhaseResult) ->
 2652:     not_committed.
 2653: 
 2654: phase_result(Ns, Phases, Kind) ->
 2655:     case lists:keyfind(Ns, 1, Phases) of
 2656:         {Ns, Results} ->
 2657:             case lists:keyfind(Kind, 1, Results) of
 2658:                 {Kind, Result} -> Result;
 2659:                 false -> not_queried
 2660:             end;
 2661:         false -> not_queried
 2662:     end.
 2663: 
 2664: dtx_internal_diagnostics(Peer, Ns) ->
 2665:     Simplex = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, Ns}]),
 2666:     case peer:call(Peer, sys, get_state, [Simplex]) of
 2667:         {running, State} ->
 2668:             Coordinator = peer:call(
 2669:                             Peer, quod_simplex,
 2670:                             test_dtx_coordinator_state, [State]),
 2671:             Counts = peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex,
 2672:                                test_dtx_endpoint_counts, [State]),
 2673:             #{coordinator => Coordinator,
 2674:               endpoint_counts => Counts};
 2675:         Other ->
 2676:             #{state => Other}
 2677:     end.
 2678: 
 2679: single_coordinator_id(Coordinators) when is_map(Coordinators) ->
 2680:     case maps:keys(Coordinators) of
 2681:         [GroupId] -> GroupId;
 2682:         _ -> undefined
 2683:     end;
 2684: single_coordinator_id(_Malformed) ->
 2685:     undefined.

 2687: wait_restarted(_Peer, _Ns, _OldSimplex, 0) ->
 2688:     ct:fail(origin_namespace_did_not_restart);
 2689: wait_restarted(Peer, Ns, OldSimplex, Retries) ->
 2690:     Simplex = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, Ns}]),
 2691:     Prolog = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, Ns}]),
 2692:     case is_pid(Simplex) andalso Simplex =/= OldSimplex andalso
 2693:          is_pid(Prolog) of
 2694:         true -> ok;
 2695:         false -> timer:sleep(25),
 2696:                  wait_restarted(Peer, Ns, OldSimplex, Retries - 1)
 2697:     end.
 2698: 
 2699: wait_group_outcome(_Peer, GroupRef, 0) ->
 2700:     ct:fail({group_outcome_never_became_terminal, GroupRef});
 2701: wait_group_outcome(Peer, {group, Ns, _, _, _, _} = GroupRef, Retries) ->
 2702:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, outcome, [GroupRef]) of
 2703:         {ok, #{status := Status} = Outcome}
 2704:           when Status =:= committed; Status =:= aborted -> Outcome;
 2705:         {ok, #{status := pending}} ->
 2706:             timer:sleep(50),
 2707:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2708:         {error, {outcome_unknown, GroupRef}} ->
 2709:             timer:sleep(50),
 2710:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2711:         {error, {ontology_rebuilding, Ns}} ->
 2712:             timer:sleep(50),
 2713:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2714:         Other ->
 2715:             ct:fail({unexpected_group_outcome, Other})
 2716:     end.
 2717: 
 2718: assert_fact_once(Peer, Ns, Predicate, Tag) ->
 2719:     Goal = {findall, ok, {Predicate, Tag}, {'Hits'}},
 2720:     ?assertMatch(
 2721:        {ok, [#{'Hits' := [ok]}], _},
 2722:        peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Goal], 10000)).
 2723: 
 2724: assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, Predicate, Tag) ->
 2725:     Goal = {findall, ok, {Predicate, Tag}, {'Hits'}},
 2726:     ?assertMatch(
 2727:        {ok, [#{'Hits' := []}], _},
 2728:        peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Goal], 10000)).

 2730: append_source_marker(Config, Tag) ->
 2731:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2732:     Author = ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 2733:     Anchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2734:     {ok, Goal} = quod_durable_term:encode_goal({test_source_marker, Tag}),
 2735:     {ok, Result} = quod_durable_term:encode_result(#{}),
 2736:     PlanDigest = crypto:hash(
 2737:                    sha256,
 2738:                    term_to_binary({test_source_marker, Tag},
 2739:                                   [deterministic])),
 2740:     Change = quod_transaction:bind_id(
 2741:                {?ASKER_NS, Anchor},
 2742:                #transaction{tx_id = <<>>,
 2743:                             origin = {?ASKER_NS, Anchor},
 2744:                             proof_id = <<0:256>>, plan_digest = PlanDigest,
 2745:                             goal = Goal, result = Result,
 2746:                             diff = [{assert,
 2747:                                      {{instance_of, pet,
 2748:                                        {stale_origin_marker, Tag}}, true}}],
 2749:                             read_check = #{}, author = Author, sig = none}),
 2750:     ?assertMatch({ok, _},
 2751:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, append,
 2752:                            [?ASKER_NS, Change], 60000)).

 2757:      {dtx_disjoint_write_chain_2, dtx_animals_mark_2,

 2759:      {dtx_disjoint_write_chain_3, dtx_animals_mark_3,
 2760:       dtx_third_write_3, dtx_third_mark_3},
 2761:      {dtx_disjoint_write_chain_4, dtx_animals_mark_4,
 2762:       dtx_third_write_4, dtx_third_mark_4},
 2763:      {dtx_disjoint_write_chain_5, dtx_animals_mark_5,
 2764:       dtx_third_write_5, dtx_third_mark_5},
 2765:      {dtx_disjoint_write_chain_6, dtx_animals_mark_6,
 2766:       dtx_third_write_6, dtx_third_mark_6},
 2767:      {dtx_disjoint_write_chain_7, dtx_animals_mark_7,

 2772: dtx_disjoint_target_rules() ->
 2773:     [io_lib:format(
 2774:        "~s(X) :- assertz(~s(X)), third::~s(X).~n",
 2775:        [atom_to_list(Chain), atom_to_list(Local),
 2776:         atom_to_list(RemoteWriter)])
 2777:      || {Chain, Local, RemoteWriter, _RemoteFact} <-
 2778:             dtx_disjoint_predicates()].

 2780: dtx_disjoint_third_rules() ->
 2781:     [io_lib:format(
 2782:        "~s(X) :- assertz(~s(X)).~n",
 2783:        [atom_to_list(RemoteWriter), atom_to_list(RemoteFact)])
 2784:      || {_Chain, _Local, RemoteWriter, RemoteFact} <-
 2785:             dtx_disjoint_predicates()].

 2787: collect_gateway_race(_Ref, 0, Results) -> lists:reverse(Results);
 2788: collect_gateway_race(Ref, Remaining, Results) ->
 2789:     receive
 2790:         {Ref, Gateway, Result} ->
 2791:             collect_gateway_race(
 2792:               Ref, Remaining - 1, [{Gateway, Result} | Results])
 2793:     after 65000 ->
 2794:         ct:fail({gateway_race_timeout, Remaining})
 2795:     end.
 2796: 
 2797: classify_race_submit(
 2798:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, _Bindings, _Outcome}}}) ->
 2799:     {accepted, Evidence};
 2800: classify_race_submit(
 2801:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {pending, _PendingRef}}}) ->
 2802:     %% A multi-ontology proof may already be durably represented by its group
 2803:     %% reference.  The signed operation remains the stable public lookup key
 2804:     %% in either case, and is resolved below without resubmitting.
 2805:     {accepted, Evidence};
 2806: classify_race_submit({error, signed_target_unavailable}) ->
 2807:     pre_custody_unavailable;
 2808: classify_race_submit({error, busy}) ->
 2809:     pre_custody_unavailable;
 2810: classify_race_submit(Other) ->
 2811:     ct:fail({gateway_race_submit_failed, Other}).

 2813: concurrent_submit_evidence(
 2814:   _Index,
 2815:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, _Bindings, _Outcome}}}) ->
 2816:     Evidence;
 2817: concurrent_submit_evidence(
 2818:   _Index,
 2819:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {pending, _PendingRef}}}) ->
 2820:     Evidence;
 2821: concurrent_submit_evidence(Index, Other) ->
 2822:     ct:fail({concurrent_signed_dtx_submit_failed, Index, Other}).

 2824: %% The losing group can be reported either while still pending or directly as
 2825: %% its certified abort. In both cases the signed evidence carries
 2826: %% the same operation reference whose final durable outcome is asserted below.
 2827: concurrent_conflict_evidence(
 2828:   _Index,
 2829:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, _Bindings, _Outcome}}}) ->
 2830:     Evidence;
 2831: concurrent_conflict_evidence(
 2832:   _Index,
 2833:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {pending, _PendingRef}}}) ->
 2834:     Evidence;
 2835: concurrent_conflict_evidence(
 2836:   _Index,
 2837:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {failed, _Reasons}}}) ->
 2838:     Evidence;
 2839: concurrent_conflict_evidence(Index, Other) ->
 2840:     ct:fail({concurrent_signed_conflict_submit_failed, Index, Other}).

 2842: wait_operation_claim(_Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 2843:     ct:fail({operation_outcome_timeout, OperationRef});
 2844: wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 2845:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 2846:         {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := OutcomeRef} = Claim} ->
 2847:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 2848:                 {ok, #{status := committed} = Outcome} -> {Claim, Outcome};
 2849:                 {ok, #{status := pending}} ->
 2850:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2851:                     wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 2852:                 {error, _} ->
 2853:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2854:                     wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 2855:                 Other ->
 2856:                     ct:fail({unexpected_operation_outcome, Other})
 2857:             end;
 2858:         {error, _} ->
 2859:             timer:sleep(50),
 2860:             wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 2861:         Other ->
 2862:             ct:fail({unexpected_operation_claim, Other})
 2863:     end.
 2864: 
 2865: completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 2866:     ct:fail(
 2867:       {operation_completion_timeout, OperationRef,
 2868:        peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, stats, [?ASKER_NS])});
 2869: completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 2870:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 2871:         {ok, #{status := claimed, operation_state := terminal,
 2872:                outcome_ref := {applications, [OutcomeRef]}, included := Included}} ->
 2873:             ?assertMatch([{_, {certified, OutcomeRef, _}}], Included),
 2874:             ?assertEqual({ok, [OutcomeRef]}, quod_operation_vector:receipt_references(Included)),
 2875:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 2876:                 {ok, #{status := committed, ref := OutcomeRef}} -> OutcomeRef;
 2877:                 _ ->
 2878:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2879:                     completed_remote_operation(
 2880:                       Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2881:             end;
 2882:         _ ->
 2883:             timer:sleep(50),
 2884:             completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2885:     end.
 2886: 
 2887: wait_operation_terminal(_Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 2888:     ct:fail({operation_outcome_timeout, OperationRef});
 2889: wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 2890:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 2891:         {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := OutcomeRef} = Claim} ->
 2892:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 2893:                 {ok, #{status := Status} = Outcome}
 2894:                   when Status =:= committed; Status =:= aborted ->
 2895:                     {Claim, Outcome};
 2896:                 _ ->
 2897:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2898:                     wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2899:             end;
 2900:         _ ->
 2901:             timer:sleep(50),
 2902:             wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2903:     end.
 2904: 
 2905: wait_remote_operation(_Gateway, _SessionId, _RequestBytes, _Signature,
 2906:                       _ClientPeer, 0) ->
 2907:     ct:fail(remote_operation_outcome_timeout);
 2908: wait_remote_operation(Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2909:                       ClientPeer, Remaining) ->
 2910:     Result = peer:call(
 2911:                Gateway, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 2912:                [SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 10000),
 2913:     case Result of
 2914:         {ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, _}} -> Result;
 2915:         {ok, _, {operation_pending, _}} when Remaining =:= 1 ->
 2916:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_timeout, Result});
 2917:         {ok, _, {operation_pending, _}} ->
 2918:             timer:sleep(250),
 2919:             wait_remote_operation(
 2920:               Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2921:               ClientPeer, Remaining - 1);
 2922:         {error, client_goal_rate_limited} when Remaining =:= 1 ->
 2923:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_timeout, Result});
 2924:         {error, client_goal_rate_limited} ->
 2925:             timer:sleep(250),
 2926:             wait_remote_operation(
 2927:               Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2928:               ClientPeer, Remaining - 1);
 2929:         Other ->
 2930:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_invalid, Other})
 2931:     end.

 2933: assert_dtx_released(Peer, Ns) ->
 2934:     Status = peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [Ns]),
 2935:     Projection = maps:get(history_projection, Status),
 2936:     Dtx = maps:get(dtx, Projection),
 2937:     ?assertEqual(#{}, maps:get(groups, Dtx)),
 2938:     ?assertEqual(#{}, maps:get(apply_fences, Dtx)).

 2940: run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, Wave) ->
 2941:     %% `run_scope_proofs/3` owns a 10-second completion window. The peer call
 2942:     %% must outlive it; its default five seconds can otherwise time out before
 2943:     %% the helper can report the actual wave result.
 2944:     Results = peer:call(
 2945:                 Asker, ?MODULE, run_scope_proofs,
 2946:                 [?ASKER_NS, Goal, ?SCOPE_WAVE_SIZE], 15000),
 2947:     case Results of
 2948:         List when is_list(List), length(List) =:= ?SCOPE_WAVE_SIZE ->
 2949:             lists:foreach(
 2950:               fun({ok, [_], _}) -> ok;
 2951:                  (Result) -> ct:fail({scope_proof_failed, Wave, Result})
 2952:               end, List);
 2953:         timeout -> ct:fail({scope_proof_timeout, Wave});
 2954:         Other -> ct:fail({scope_proof_wave_failed, Wave, Other})
 2955:     end.
 2956: 
 2957: run_scope_proofs(Ns, Goal, Count) ->
 2958:     Parent = self(),
 2959:     _ = [spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {proof_done, quod_prolog:prove(Ns, Goal)} end)
 2960:          || _ <- lists:seq(1, Count)],
 2961:     collect_scope_proofs(Count, []).
 2962: 
 2963: collect_scope_proofs(0, Results) -> lists:reverse(Results);
 2964: collect_scope_proofs(Count, Results) ->
 2965:     receive
 2966:         {proof_done, Result} -> collect_scope_proofs(Count - 1, [Result | Results])
 2967:     after 10000 ->
 2968:         timeout
 2969:     end.

 2971: set_network_identity(Peer, NetworkId) ->
 2972:     Desired = peer:call(
 2973:                 Peer, application, get_env,
 2974:                 [quod, namespace_desired, #{}]),
 2975:     Content = maps:get(content, Desired, #{}),
 2976:     ok = peer:call(
 2977:            Peer, application, set_env,
 2978:            [quod, namespace_desired,
 2979:             Desired#{content => Content#{
 2980:               quod_ontology:root_ns() => #{genesis_hash => NetworkId}}}]).

 2982: open_client_session(Peer, NetworkId, NodeKey,
 2983:                     KeyPair = {PublicKey, _Seed}, ClientPeer) ->
 2984:     ClientNonce = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 2985:     {ok, Challenge} = peer:call(
 2986:                         Peer, quod_client_auth, issue_challenge,
 2987:                         [PublicKey, ClientNonce, ClientPeer]),
 2988:     ChallengeId = maps:get(challenge_id, Challenge),
 2989:     {ok, ChallengeBytes} = quod_client_auth:challenge_bytes(
 2990:                              NetworkId, NodeKey, ChallengeId, PublicKey,
 2991:                              ClientNonce, maps:get(server_nonce, Challenge),
 2992:                              maps:get(expires_ms, Challenge)),
 2993:     Signature = quod_identity:sign(
 2994:                   ChallengeBytes, quod_identity:key_term(KeyPair)),
 2995:     {ok, Session} = peer:call(
 2996:                       Peer, quod_client_auth, complete_challenge,
 2997:                       [ChallengeId, Signature]),
 2998:     Session.

 3000: signed_goal_request(NetworkId, PublicKey, KeyPair, AgentNamespace, AgentAnchor,
 3001:                     SessionExpires, GoalText) ->
 3002:     signed_goal_request(NetworkId, PublicKey, KeyPair,
 3003:                         AgentNamespace, AgentAnchor,
 3004:                         SessionExpires, execute, GoalText).
 3005: 
 3006: signed_goal_request(NetworkId, PublicKey, KeyPair,
 3007:                     AgentNamespace, AgentAnchor,
 3008:                     SessionExpires, Mode, GoalText) ->
 3009:     Request = #{network_identity => NetworkId,
 3010:                 signing_public_key => PublicKey,
 3011:                 operation_id => crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 3012:                 agent_namespace => AgentNamespace,
 3013:                 agent_genesis_anchor => AgentAnchor,
 3014:                 agent_instance_text => <<"human_user(test_agent).">>,
 3015:                 mode => Mode, parser_version => 1,
 3016:                 not_after_ms => min(
 3017:                                   SessionExpires,
 3018:                                   quod_time:now_ms() + 30000),
 3019:                 goal_text => GoalText},
 3020:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_client_goal:encode(Request),
 3021:     {Bytes,
 3022:      quod_identity:sign(Bytes, quod_identity:key_term(KeyPair))}.
 3023: 
 3024: submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText) ->
 3025:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 3026:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 3027:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 3028:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 3029:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 3030:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 3031:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 3032:                                   ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 3033:                                   maps:get(expires_ms, Session), execute,
 3034:                                   GoalText),
 3035:     peer:call(
 3036:       ?config(asker, Config), quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 3037:       [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), RequestBytes, Signature,
 3038:        ?config(client_peer, Config)], 60000).

 3040: prolog_binary_literal(Bytes) ->
 3041:     iolist_to_binary(
 3042:       ["<<\"",
 3043:        [["\\x", io_lib:format("~2.16.0B", [Byte]), "\\"]
 3044:         || <<Byte>> <= Bytes],
 3045:        "\">>"]).

 3047: start_node(Name, Port, {Pub, Seed}, Ns, Genesis, Seeds,
 3048:            DirectoryAllowlist, Config) ->
 3049:     %% Peer nodes must load the beam being tested.  `code:get_path/0` also
 3050:     %% contains dependency and older build paths, so put this suite's exact
 3051:     %% Quod ebin first instead of relying on their incidental ordering.
 3052:     QuodEbin = filename:dirname(code:which(quod_simplex)),
 3053:     PeerPaths = [QuodEbin | lists:delete(QuodEbin, code:get_path())],
 3054:     {ok, Peer, _Node} = peer:start(
 3055:                           #{name => Name, connection => standard_io,
 3056:                             args => ["-pa" | PeerPaths]}),
 3057:     lists:foreach(
 3058:       fun(Module) ->
 3059:           {module, Module} = peer:call(
 3060:                                Peer, code, ensure_loaded, [Module]),
 3061:           QuodEbin = filename:dirname(
 3062:                        peer:call(Peer, code, which, [Module]))
 3063:       end, [quod_simplex, quod_scope_session, quod_ask]),
 3064:     true = peer:call(
 3065:              Peer, erlang, function_exported,
 3066:              [quod_simplex, start_link, 2]),
 3067:     %% Runtime lifecycle preparation may legitimately use the application's
 3068:     %% default data root. Keep that root private to this peer and CT run: the
 3069:     %% VM-local unique_integer/1 sequence restarts in later runs, so sharing
 3070:     %% the developer cache could reopen an old genesis under a dead test key.
 3071:     CacheDir = filename:join(
 3072:                  ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3073:                  atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_cache"),
 3074:     true = peer:call(
 3075:              Peer, os, putenv, ["XDG_CACHE_HOME", CacheDir]),
 3076:     _ = peer:call(Peer, logger, set_primary_config, [level, warning]),
 3077:     _ = peer:call(Peer, application, load, [quod]),
 3078:     Key = quod_identity:key_term({Pub, Seed}),
 3079:     Set = fun(K, V) -> ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, K, V]) end,
 3080:     Set(listen_port, Port),
 3081:     Set(node_addr, {"127.0.0.1", Port}),
 3082:     Set(node_pubkey, Pub),
 3083:     Set(identity_key, Key),
 3084:     Set(identity_cert, quod_identity:mint_cert({Pub, Seed})),
 3085:     Set(effect_journal_data_dir,
 3086:         filename:join(
 3087:           ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3088:           atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_effect_journal")),
 3089:     Set(foreign_log,
 3090:         #{cache_dir => filename:join(
 3091:                          ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3092:                          atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_foreign_log")}),
 3093:     %% These peers do not run the production directory-advertisement loop for
 3094:     %% every synthetic namespace. Keep their explicit certified route fixtures
 3095:     %% alive for the whole suite so long-running protocol cases test the route,
 3096:     %% not fixture expiry.
 3097:     _ = DirectoryAllowlist,
 3098:     Set(directory, #{ttl_ms => 600000, expire_tick_ms => 60000}),
 3099:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, application, ensure_all_started, [quod]),
 3100:     start_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Genesis, Seeds, Config),
 3101:     Peer.
 3102: 
 3103: start_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Genesis, Seeds, Config) ->
 3104:     DataDir = filename:join(
 3105:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3106:                 unicode:characters_to_list(
 3107:                   [atom_to_list(peer:call(Peer, erlang, node, [])),
 3108:                    "_", Ns])),
 3109:     Cfg = #{node_id => Pub, mode => create, role => member,
 3110:             data_dir => DataDir, seed_peers => Seeds,
 3111:             genesis_file => Genesis},
 3112:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [Ns, Cfg]),
 3113:     ok.

 3120:                    "_observer_", Ns])),
 3121:     Cfg = #{node_id => Pub, mode => join, genesis_hash => Anchor,
 3122:             data_dir => DataDir, seed_peers => Seeds},
 3123:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [Ns, Cfg]),

 3126: start_root_namespace(Peer, Pub, Config) ->

 3147: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal) ->
 3148:     wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, 750).

 3150: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, _Goal, 0) ->
 3151:     ct:fail(
 3152:       {ontology_never_ready, Ns,
 3153:        #{children => peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, children, []),
 3154:          desired => peer:call(
 3155:                       Peer, application, get_env,
 3156:                       [quod, namespace_desired, undefined]),
 3157:          genesis => peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
 3158:          status => peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [Ns]),
 3159:          prolog => peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, stats, [Ns])}});
 3160: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, Retries) ->
 3161:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Goal], 5000) of
 3162:         {error, rebuilding} ->
 3163:             timer:sleep(20),
 3164:             wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, Retries - 1);
 3165:         {ok, _, _} -> ok;
 3166:         Other -> ct:fail({not_ready, Ns, Other})
 3167:     end.

 3169: wait_scope_workers(_Peer, _Expected, 0) -> ct:fail(scope_worker_timeout);
 3170: wait_scope_workers(Peer, Expected, Retries) ->

 3173: wait_engine_stat(_Peer, _Ns, _Key, _Expected, 0) ->
 3174:     ct:fail(engine_stat_timeout);
 3175: wait_engine_stat(Peer, Ns, Key, Expected, Retries) ->
 3176:     Stats = peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, stats, [Ns]),
 3177:     case maps:get(Key, Stats, undefined) of
 3178:         Expected -> ok;
 3179:         _ ->
 3180:             timer:sleep(10),
 3181:             wait_engine_stat(Peer, Ns, Key, Expected, Retries - 1)
 3182:     end.

 3184: key_before(TargetPub) ->
 3185:     {Pub, _} = Key = quod_identity:generate(),
 3186:     case Pub < TargetPub of
 3187:         true -> Key;
 3188:         false -> key_before(TargetPub)
 3189:     end.

 3191: deep_failure_rules() ->
 3192:     [[io_lib:format("deep_failure(~B) :- deep_failure(~B).~n", [N, N - 1])
 3193:       || N <- lists:seq(70, 1, -1)],
 3194:      "deep_failure(0) :- fail_with_reason(deep_bottom).\n",
 3195:      %% Build the deliberately over-depth reason at proof time.  Canonical
 3196:      %% ledger material is depth-bounded, so embedding that value as a genesis
 3197:      %% literal would test genesis rejection instead of reply truncation.
 3198:      "bounded_reason :- deep_reason_value(63, deep_bottom, Reason), !, "
 3199:      "fail_with_reason(Reason).\n"
 3200:      "deep_reason :- deep_reason_value(70, deep_bottom, Reason), !, "
 3201:      "fail_with_reason(Reason).\n"
 3202:      "deep_reason_value(0, Acc, Acc).\n"
 3203:      "deep_reason_value(N, Acc, Out) :- N > 0, Next is N - 1, "
 3204:      "deep_reason_value(Next, [Acc], Out).\n"].
